The graph’s current form places 口 on the left and 夕 on the right. The received analysis treats both as semantic elements: 夕 supplies the evening setting and 口 the speaking/name idea in the account of identifying oneself in darkness. A secondary proposal assigns 夕 a phonetic role, but it remains unverified; the original motivation is unresolved.

夕 is the right-hand element. In the received explanation of 名, it supplies the evening setting. Separately, 夕 and 月 once shared a moon-like form; their later graphic differentiation belongs to their own histories, not a change within 名.

口 is the left-hand element. In the received explanation, it contributes the speaking/name idea as a semantic element. The cited accounts identify it in 名 but do not describe a separate graphic history for it within this character.
